summary: Complaints centre on unannounced power cuts and waterlogged, potholed roads in Noorpur town and the Dhampur-Noorpur road, with flood-hit sugarcane losses; appreciation is limited to district-level health services and a bypass that is nearly built.

positives.english: Now we get good treatment in Bijnor itself, no need to go to Delhi or Meerut
positives.hindi: अब दिल्ली-मेरठ नहीं जाना पड़ता, बिजनौर में ही इलाज हो रहा है
positives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala Bijnor ground report (21 Aug 2026) quotes Assistant Professor Amit Gupta of the Mahatma Vidur Autonomous State Medical College saying earlier district patients had to go to Delhi or Meerut; the article is read as saying treatment is now available in Bijnor.

positives.english: Inference: the Bijnor bypass is nearly built, so traffic should move outside the city
positives.hindi: *बाईपास लगभग बनकर तैयार, शहर के बाहर से गाड़ियां निकलेंगी
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (21 Sep 2026) says the 8 km Bijnor bypass is 92% complete and NHAI SDO Ashish Sharma says it will be opened to vehicles by 15 October 2026; the report does not mention Noorpur or Chandpur, so its effect on this AC is not confirmed. Zee News Hindi (31 Dec 2024) says it will take Chandpur road and Noorpur road jams out of the city.

positives.english: Inference: Noorpur has several schools and colleges, so study facilities exist locally
positives.hindi: *नूरपुर में कई स्कूल और कॉलेज हैं, पढ़ाई की सुविधा है
positives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia's Noorpur town article says the town has a wide variety of schools and colleges, from government schools to high-fee private schools; students also travel to Moradabad and Bijnor for education. No details on condition or capacity, and no news report on local schools was found. Noorpur town is inside the AC per the Wikipedia AC extent (Noorpur MB).

positives.english: Beautification work was done at Vidur Kuti in Bijnor after the government changed
positives.hindi: सरकार बदलने के बाद विदुर कुटी का सौंदर्यीकरण हुआ
positives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala Bijnor ground report (21 Aug 2026) quotes the chief priest of Vidur Kuti saying beautification work was done there after the government changed; the article is about Bijnor city, not Noorpur.

positives.english: Inference: a proposal to expand Noorpur municipal limits would bring town facilities to nearby villages
positives.hindi: *नगर पालिका का दायरा बढ़ेगा, शहर की सुविधाएं गांवों तक पहुंचेंगी
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (29 Jul 2025) reports the DM endorsed expanding Noorpur municipal board (area 9.06 to 11.48 sq km) to include Pipla Jagir and Noorpur Dehat (Theri), and that the proposal awaits state approval. This is an announcement only, not a delivered benefit.

negatives.english: Power keeps going off again and again in Noorpur town, hurting business day and night
negatives.hindi: नूरपुर शहर में बार-बार बिजली गुल, दिन-रात कारोबार पर असर
negatives.basis: Noorpur city (inside the AC: Noorpur MB is in the AC's Chandpur tehsil extent per Wikipedia). Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026): after storm and rain, traders in Noorpur city protested unannounced power cuts; repeated day and night outages were hurting business; the SDO said the problem would be resolved soon.

negatives.english: Every monsoon the Dhampur-Noorpur road fills with water and deep potholes, and vehicles get stuck for hours
negatives.hindi: धामपुर-नूरपुर सड़क पर हर बारिश में गड्ढे और पानी, घंटों जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026): on the Dhampur-Noorpur road near Dheli Ahir village, the Gangan river rose and submerged the road; vehicles were stuck for hours and traffic was disrupted for three days. The report says waterlogging at this spot occurs every monsoon year. ADM Anshika Dixit ordered potholes filled. AC membership of Dheli Ahir is unconfirmed, so this is not counted as AC-specific.

negatives.english: Sugarcane crop in the Noorpur area was destroyed by red rot and river flooding
negatives.hindi: नूरपुर इलाके में गन्ने की फसल लाल सड़न और बाढ़ से खराब हुई
negatives.basis: District-level area list, dated 2024: ChiniMandi (14 Mar 2024) quotes Manoj Kumar Kont, Special Secretary of the Dhampur Sugarcane Committee, that about 25-30 per cent of the cane crop in Dhampur, Seohara, Bilai, Afzalgarh and Noorpur was destroyed by red rot disease and river flooding. Noorpur is named among five areas. No later figure found.

negatives.english: Jams on the Noorpur road are hard to get out of
negatives.hindi: नूरपुर रोड पर जाम लगता है, शहर से निकलना मुश्किल होता है
negatives.basis: District-level, AC membership of these roads unconfirmed: Zee News Hindi (31 Dec 2024) says the planned bypass will take jams on the Chandpur road and Noorpur road out of Bijnor city. The article does not give how often the jams occur.

negatives.english: Inference: in villages, a tree branch touching the power line cuts supply
negatives.hindi: *देहात में पेड़ की टहनी तार छूए तो बिजली गुल हो जाती है
negatives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026) says rural power cuts were caused by trees and branches touching the lines. The report is Bijnor district-level and does not name Noorpur AC villages.

notes: AC 24 Noorpur, Bijnor district, reserved status None confirmed from the Wikipedia AC page (extent: Chandpur tehsil part with Noorpur MB, and Sahaspur NP of Dhampur tehsil). Chelapur: its Wikipedia village page says it is in Chandpur tehsil and forms part of the Noorpur Vidhan Sabha constituency, so Chelapur is inside this AC. No current Chelapur issue was found; the only Chelapur Amar Ujala reference on that page is a 2012 jam report known only by its headline, so it is not used. Local sourcing is still thin: about 30 Hindi and English searches found no Noorpur-specific 2024-2026 report on drainage, water supply, schools, CHC or hospital services, sugarcane dues or road repairs. Only negative 1 is clearly AC-specific and sourced; negative 3 names Noorpur among five areas (district-level). Negative 2 is on the Dhampur-Noorpur road near Dheli Ahir, whose AC membership is unconfirmed. Negative 4 concerns roads with unconfirmed AC location. Checked and rejected: Amar Ujala 12 Oct 2026 heavy-vehicle ban on the Bijnor-Noorpur route (railway maintenance, 12-13 Oct, not a local problem); Amar Ujala 2 Aug 2026 Bukhara power house cuts (Bijnor city, not Noorpur); Amar Ujala 23 May 2026 power tripping (Dhampur and Najibabad, not Noorpur); Amar Ujala 30 Dec 2022 canal overflow (Afzalgarh, not Noorpur); Sept 2026 Noorpur murder story (single crime); Himachal Pradesh Nurpur results. Bijnor bypass: due to open by 15 October 2026 per the 21 Sep 2026 report; opening after that date was not confirmed as of 12 Oct 2026. Dheli Ahir AC membership and the bypass effect on this AC remain unconfirmed. Field check needed: drainage and waterlogging in Noorpur town, water supply, Noorpur CHC services, sugarcane dues to mills, and whether Dheli Ahir lies in this AC.

round2.changes: Verified all 8 cited URLs (11 source entries) against the article text; all supported. Corrected basis texts: removed unsupported claims (Vidur Kuti 'wider improvement', 'residents say' attribution, Noorpur 'urban facilities' reason, 'next-day restoration' in rural power cut, Bukhara power house link). Reworded positive 3 and reworded positive 1 basis to match the article quotes (statement unchanged). Re-ranked positives (schools inference to 3, Vidur Kuti to 4). Confirmed Noorpur AC extent and Chelapur village membership from Wikipedia. Ran 25+ new searches; no new sourced Noorpur-specific negative or positive was found. Rejected heavy-vehicle ban (railway work), Bukhara and Chandpur-district power cuts, Afzalgarh canal (2022). Kept 4 inference items.
